definitions.explanation: A pyramid in the geometric sense — a solid with a polygonal base and triangular faces meeting at a single point. Used for the abstract shape; the Egyptian monument is called ピラミッド.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四角錐|しかくすい}→四角錐：23629_shikakusui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
{角錐|かくすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Find the volume of a pyramid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{底面|ていめん}→底面：22041_teimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三角形|さんかっけい}→三角形：09753_sankakkei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角錐|かくすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三角錐|さんかくすい}→三角錐：29329_sankakusui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: A pyramid whose base is a triangle is called a triangular pyramid (tetrahedron).

notes:
Compound of {角|かく} (corner; angle) + {錐|すい} (a tapering/awl-like shape). Used almost only in math class and technical contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{三角錐|さんかくすい}→三角錐：29329_sankakusui⟧: triangular pyramid (tetrahedron)
- ⟦{四角錐|しかくすい}→四角錐：23629_shikakusui⟧: square pyramid
- {六角錐|ろっかくすい}: hexagonal pyramid

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{円錐|えんすい}→円錐：05550_ensui⟧: cone — circular base instead of polygonal
- ⟦{角柱|かくちゅう}→角柱：28899_kakuchuu⟧: prism — two parallel polygonal faces instead of a point at the top
- ⟦ピラミッド→ピラミッド：11280_piramiddo⟧: pyramid (Egyptian monument; loanword)
